questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Muscat?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Oman is Muscat.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Oman?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Oman article.

questions.proof: The capital is Muscat, Oman has a total area of 322,731 km² which makes it slightly bigger than Ivory Coast.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Oman about 309,500 square kilometres; Syria about 185,180 square kilometres; Azerbaijan about 86,600 square kilometres; Qatar about 11,437 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Oman?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Oman on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Oman article.

questions.proof: It borders the United Arab Emirates to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the west, and Yemen to the southwest.
